personality_one_liner: A fast, uncompromised, content-first cinematic experience that uses dark utility layouts to frame videos as the ultimate hero.

spacing.rule: Handle spacing correctly dont have extra spaces where its not required, handle padding and margin corectly and subtle for buttons and components

do's: Use subtle glass if absolutely needed for floating playback controls over active video, but lean solid/gradient for maximum contrast.
dont's: No glass on headers, bottom tabs, or cards. Keep it brutal, dark, and performant.

screens.name: Home Feed
screens.purpose: A vertical scroll of highly engaging video content.

states.loading: Dark skeletal loading blocks imitating video aspect ratios.
states.empty: Subtle empty state illustration with 'No videos yet' and a CTA to pull-to-refresh.
states.error: Error message with a prominent Retry button in brandPrimary.

screens.layout: Edge-to-edge video thumbnails with title, channel name, and views underneath. Use a row-based layout (single column, full width). Do not use cards or side-padding on the thumbnail; the video should span 100% of the screen width for maximum impact. Divider lines between items.

screens.name: Video Player

states.loading: Center spinner over a darkened thumbnail.
states.error: Video failed to load error message in the center of the player.

screens.layout: Follow Mobbin gestures: Tap for controls, double tap for seek, drag for timeline scrubbing. Floating UI controls layered over the video player with a top-to-bottom transparent-to-black gradient scrim guaranteeing readability for controls.

screens.name: Upload
screens.purpose: A strict, simple form to upload videos and agree to the No-AI policy.

states.loading: Uploading progress bar (in brandPrimary) at the bottom or overlay.
states.empty: Empty drop zone with a large 'Select Video' button.

screens.layout: Single column form. A large tap target to select from gallery. Explicit 'I confirm this is not AI generated' checkbox. Fixed Submit CTA pinned to the bottom above the keyboard using KeyboardAvoidingView.

screens.name: Paywall
screens.purpose: Gate access to the app until the $1/mo subscription is paid.

states.loading: Processing payment spinner inside the CTA.
states.error: Payment failed state highlighting the Stripe error.

screens.layout: Cinematic full-bleed background image with a heavy dark gradient scrim over it. The $1/month value proposition is centered in large Barlow Condensed type. A large brandPrimary button anchored at the bottom thumb zone to initiate payment.

screens.name: Profile
screens.purpose: Showcase user's own videos and subscriptions.

states.loading: Skeleton loaders for stats and video grid.
states.empty: Empty state illustration indicating user hasn't uploaded any videos yet.

screens.layout: Top section with user avatar (real image or initial), subscriber count. Bottom section is a 2-column or 3-column grid of video thumbnails the user has uploaded, separated by tight margins.

thumbnail_landscape.alt: Aerial view of green mountains forming a cinematic landscape thumbnail.

thumbnail_vlog.alt: A creator filming a cooking tutorial in a modern setting.

paywall_background.alt: Dark moody interior of an empty theater to symbolize premium viewing.

empty_state_illustration.alt: Red theater curtain acting as an empty state visual.

instructions_to_main_agent: Always use the typography size hierarchy outlined in the scale (12, 14, 16, 20, 24). Do not use pixel sizes directly.
Do NOT use indigo, blue, or purple anywhere. Default to `#E63946` (Signal Red) for core actions, and the dark surfaces for everything else.
Implement the 'Dark-First Utility' personality. Elements should have 0 shadow tier, sharp or small radius (sm/md), and act as a live operational surface.
Ensure 'No AI content' constraints are clearly messaged on the Upload screen.
On the Home Feed, use 100% width edge-to-edge images for video thumbnails to prioritize the content, matching Mobbin UI patterns.
For the Player, ensure you implement standard mobile gestures: Tap to toggle controls, Double Tap for seek, and dragging for scrubbing.
Always apply a dark linear gradient scrim under text that sits on top of images (e.g. video durations, titles on the paywall).
